feedback: Users keep asking how to reset their password.
A wrong password currently shows a red banner at the top of the form.
decisions: Add a "Forgot password?" link under the password field that opens a reset page where users enter their email.
Show login errors inline, in red text under the field; keep the banner only for network errors.
actions: Build the "Forgot password?" link and reset page UI this sprint (the backend reset endpoint already exists).
Move credential errors inline under the field.
open_questions: Is the show/hide password toggle from the design already implemented? Luca thinks it was added last sprint but is not sure.

feedback: The orders table stays as it is.
The orders API call is hardcoded to 7 days.
decisions: Add a date range filter above the table: last 7, 30 and 90 days, plus a custom range with two date pickers. Default stays 7 days.
Add an "Export CSV" button next to the filter that exports exactly the rows shown for the selected range. High priority: finance asked twice.
Show an empty state with a short message when there are no orders.
actions: Add a date range parameter to the orders API call.
Build the date range filter, the CSV export and the empty state.
